messages:
Maria Gutierrez: Heads up — we've had 6 interviewers report that the training session RSVP links in the ATS expire after 7 days and then the slot disappears from their view. Causing no-shows and manual rebooks.
Kevin Li: omg that's been happening to a few of my new grads. they sign up -> link goes stale -> they think they never signed up.
Ash Patel: is this the LMS integration or the ATS calendar link?
Maria Gutierrez: ATS-generated session page. The link token TTL looks short. Ops-bot posted an event earlier for a batch session and 3 people couldn't access it.
ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-482 — training-link-ttl; assigned to eng-ops.
Jules: quick question — do we send calendar invites at sign-up?
Kevin Li: we do, but invites are coming from the ATS system account and some recipients report the calendar invite doesn't show the session page link after the TTL. calendar invite remains but join link 404s.
Samir Khan: could be tokenized URLs that expire. We saw this pattern with onboarding docs last year when we rotated a signing key.
Ash Patel: I dug into the ATS webhook yesterday — the session page uses a signed token param that defaults to 7d. There's a setting but it's not exposed in the UI.
Maria Gutierrez: temporary mitigation ideas? We need to avoid manual rebooks.
Kevin Li: short-term: can we add the static calendar join URL (hosted on training.redwood.com) to the invite body so even if the token expires they can still join?
Ash Patel: yes we can add a fallback link, but that requires a small change to the ATS email template. I can patch it, but will need a release window.
Jules: operational workarounds: recruiters can export the attendee CSV and send a bulk calendar invite from People Ops. Not ideal long-term.
Samir Khan: engineering ask: expose TTL config or make token refreshable via the control plane. Also add an admin override to extend individual session tokens.
Maria Gutierrez: agree. Product: please prioritize 'persistent training links' toggle. This is hitting onboarding velocity.
Ash Patel: @product-team (cc Kevin/Jules) — will open a PR with the template fallback + a ticket to the product board for TTL configuration. ETA for temp fallback: today EOD, ETA for config on prod: next sprint.
Kevin Li: thanks. For immediate damage control I'll run a manual export and send invites from People Ops for this week's sessions.
Jules: can someone add a note to the recruiter playbook about verifying the session link 24h before start? saved us last time.
Maria Gutierrez: done — added a one-line checklist and sent workspace link.
ops-bot: Update: INC-2026-482 status changed to in_progress.
Ash Patel: quick patch command I'm going to run for the email template (for devs):

# replace {{session_url}} with {{session_url_fallback}} if token expired
sed -i 's/{{session_url}}/{{session_url}}\nFallback: {{session_url_fallback}}/' services/ats/templates/session_email.html

Maria Gutierrez: perfect. please post when the patch is live so recruiters can stop manual outreach.
Ash Patel: will do. notifying infra for a hotfix window.
Kevin Li: appreciate the quick turn. also tagging this for the onboarding analytics audit — we should measure no-show delta after fix.
Samir Khan: added a note to the backlog: training-link-persistence + analytics.
Maria Gutierrez: thanks team.
